message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most significant prophetic figure. He is seen as the fulfillment of the Old‑Testament prophecies and the ultimate revelation of God’s will. While other prophets—such as Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and John the Baptist—are highly respected and play crucial roles in the biblical narrative, Jesus is considered the central and final prophet in Christianity.
